claim.operational_target: Measure whether support-conditioned person-specific predictors improve binary choice probability on unseen scenarios and later-time scenarios for held-out synthetic people.
non_claims: The learned representation is the person's mind, beliefs, values, personality, or consciousness.
Synthetic benchmark recovery transfers to real people.
Observed predictive differences identify a causal psychological mechanism.
alternatives: Apparent gain is scenario or split leakage.
A simple personal logistic model is sufficient and a neural model adds no value.
claim.scope: Synthetic held-out people, one five-feature structured binary-choice task, declared support sizes, scenario holdout, temporal holdout, and OOD diagnostic split.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Held-out people receive support-only adaptation and are evaluated on disjoint unseen scenarios; correct-person, wrong-person, population, and neural baselines are compared by paired probability metrics.
unidentified_questions: Psychological and causal meanings of learned dimensions are unidentified.
The finite synthetic generator does not identify performance outside its model family.

evidence.completeness_boundary: The deterministic generator fixes synthetic run completeness; this does not establish completeness, chronology, or provenance for real collection.

computation.deployment_kernel: One probability method per fitted baseline, reused unchanged by scenario and temporal evaluation.
computation.selection_kernel: No model selection is performed in v1; engineering parameters are fixed and validation people remain unused and reserved.
computation.uncertainty_scope: Point metrics on one fixed synthetic seed; across-person intervals and cross-seed uncertainty are not yet implemented.
computation.order_invariant: logistic baselines tested; neural order invariance not separately tested

gates.base_eligibility: fixed synthetic schema and hard sample floors
gates.temporal_direction_and_expiry: temporal direction checked; expiry not implemented

artifacts.integrity_bound: dataset SHA-256 content digest; no external signature
artifacts.raw_evidence_recomputable: in-memory generated dataset is recomputable from config; saved report JSON does not embed raw records
artifacts.old_version_refused: config and dataset versions refused; report loading is not implemented

results.summary: Compile check passed for benchmark module, public exports, and CLI.
151/151 full regression tests passed in 140.837 seconds.

remaining_limitations: The first benchmark is synthetic and single-domain.
The first neural baseline is not a HyperNetwork.
A five-seed deterministic audit exists, but no confidence interval or statistical power analysis is implemented.
Stable model-family misspecification recovery is not tested in this benchmark.
The benchmark has no external signature or trusted timestamp.
Open-text answers, memory, beliefs, values, goals, and multimodal evidence are outside v1.
Real-data completeness and truthful timestamps require an external collection system.
